mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5.0% signals continued monetary tightening, increasing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and reducing valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market with strong employment growth, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings stability, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 1350 thousand units and industrial production below 101.0 index signals resource misallocation toward housing at the expense of manufacturing output, indicating economic fragility that reduces equity risk appetite and causes negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 30% of instances when both HOUST >1350 and INDPRO <101.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 >2.5% annualized) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate profitability and positive equity market sentiment, producing S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPIAUCSL above 310.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that increase cost of capital and reduce equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 35% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 310.0.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment above 157 million persons indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending growth and corporate earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 30% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 157 million.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate above 5.0% and retail sales below 700,000 million dollars indicates aggressive monetary tightening combined with weak consumer spending, reducing equity market risk appetite and causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 25% of instances when both FEDFUNDS >5.0 and RSAFS <700000.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100.5 index during late-cycle economic phases signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 35% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.5 during late-cycle periods.
